summary: An interactive Three.js 3D Zen garden created as a single HTML file by Claude Opus 5.5, featuring dynamic canvas heightmap displacement for sand raking and lighting modes for morning, golden hour, and night.
summaryEn: Interactive 3D Zen Garden with Rakeable Sand

post.originalText:
I BUILT A ZEN GARDEN I CAN RAKE WITHOUT OWNING A RAKE

Opus 5.5 wrote it as one html file. drag across the sand and the rake cuts grooves behind the cursor. switch the time of day and the whole garden relights.

what's inside:

> SAND - a 1536px heightmap on a 440×440 grid, every drag repaints it
> RAKE - 5 grooves and 6 ridges per stroke, cut along your path
> LIGHT - golden hour drops the sun low, so every groove throws a shadow
> GARDEN - 5 mossy rocks, 2 stone lanterns, a maple with 420 leaves
> FIXES - 3 rounds: moss showing through the sand, blocky rocks, lanterns out of frame

the part that makes it feel real is not the 3D. it is the low sun. the same grooves are almost invisible in the morning and look carved at golden hour.

touching grass is for people with a lawn. i rake sand at golden hour.
